com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Builders may spend Minergy to place blocks they do not have. Blocks placed this way drop nothing.
Fallback: real blocks first, Minergy when missing. First: Minergy first, real blocks when Minergy runs out.
com.minergy.gui.info.title: Colony Minergy
com.minergy.gui.info.help: The town hall generates 1 Minergy per second as soon as it is placed, and the Mystical Mage much more while working. 1 Minergy places 1 block for a builder. A block placed with Minergy drops nothing when broken. 120 Minergy buy a +50% speed boost for a citizen for 60 s (Boost tab). The best Library of the colony holds the settings.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.flow: Can you feel it? The Minergy flows through this place like a quiet river.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.stone: A block of Minergy looks like stone, feels like stone... but it is only a thought made solid.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.builders: Tell the builders not to worry about missing blocks. I will weave them what they need.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.ephemeral: Break a block made of Minergy and nothing remains. That is the price of a gift.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.colony: This Minergy is bound to our colony. It would fade away anywhere else.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.focus: Shhh... one more breath, one more block for the colony.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.full: The receptacle overflows! The builders should use our Minergy before it goes to waste.
com.minergy.gui.boost.title: Boost a citizen
com.minergy.boost.success: %s is boosted: +%s%% work and walking speed for %s s (-%s Minergy).
com.minergy.boost.notenough: Not enough Minergy: this boost costs %s.
com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: Above this Minergy stock, the Mystical Mage stops meditating and walks around the colony to boost the workers, builders first. 0 = never.
Boost given by the mage to each worker: 1 step = +50% speed for 60 s, for 120 Minergy.
com.minergy.mage.dialogue.boost: There you go, a little Minergy in your legs. Now hurry!
